style: 3D black office comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE white goose clerk: big tomato-red vest, orange sleeve covers, long neck.
second_characters: ONE squinting mole boss: purple vest, round glasses. THREE beaver colleagues: lime-green shirts, sad eyebrows. ONE new goose at the end, same look, happy.
props: Giant pink piggy bank, goose-tall: the goose's hamster ball, his neck out of the slot; later a rind. Long clear straw: the mole's. Rack of yellow shovels with scarlet bows: the mole's; one goes to the goose. Round steel lids in the floor, each with a faded red bow. A second pink bank: the new goose's.
environment: Sunny turquoise skyscraper office, yellow floor tiles. Huge window; above it a navy sign, big white Cyrillic letters "БАНК РОССИИ", sharp and readable. Door at the far wall.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, hot-pink rim right; red vest, pink bank, scarlet bows vivid in every shot.

light_events.event: sun beam follows him down the hole

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; cuts only at 2.20, 4.40, 6.80, 9.20; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose dry deadpan adult voice; mole smug low voice
